source.publisher: Whole Building Design Guide (WBDG) / U.S. federal Unified Facilities Guide Specifications
source.title: Building Commissioning
source.source_version_note: The public document states UFGS-01 91 00.15, May 2023, Change 3 - 08/24, and supersedes earlier 2019/2021 sections.
source.rights_and_provenance: Publicly accessible source; this dataset stores authored summaries and source pointers, not a redistributed copy of the source PDF. Reuse permissions for derivative redistribution have not been separately adjudicated.
source.applicability_warning: This is a guide specification, not a project-specific executed contract. Its instructions require tailoring to the project, including choosing applicable options and removing requirements not used by the project. Never treat a generic UFGS clause as binding on a live project without checking the actual project specification, approved submittal requirements, owner's checklist, and contract amendments.

requirements.summary: The guide specification tells the editor to adapt the text to the specific project, select relevant options, and remove requirements that do not apply.
requirements.machine_checkable_expectation: Every enabled rule in a real-project assessment must cite the project's own requirement source and an applicability decision; unresolved applicability is UNKNOWN.

requirements.summary: An issues log tracks each commissioning issue from identification through resolution. The described record includes a unique reference, requirement reference, equipment/location, first observation, proposed resolution, subsequent observations and final resolution confirmation; issues are not to be deleted.
requirements.machine_checkable_expectation: Check unique issue identity, link to applicable requirement and equipment, observation/resolution chronology, explicit final resolution, and retained history.

requirements.summary: Before commissioning tests are scheduled for a system, the specification calls for a readiness certificate stating inspections are complete, open issues are resolved, and the system is ready; it calls for Government approval before scheduling.
requirements.machine_checkable_expectation: For a project profile that includes this clause, block the readiness verdict if inspection completion, open-issue closure, certificate evidence, approver identity/authority, or approval time cannot be evidenced.

requirements.summary: Commissioning tests must follow the commissioning standard named in the project and relevant technical specification sections; examples include functional-performance and integrated-systems tests.
requirements.machine_checkable_expectation: Each declared test links to its applicable approved project procedure/standard and records the applicable requirement revision.

requirements.summary: When a deficiency is found, the specification describes correcting it and retesting to confirm correction without negatively affecting the rest of the system. Tests should be aborted when a deficiency prevents successful completion or a required team member is absent.
requirements.machine_checkable_expectation: Require a trace from original failed/aborted result to documented corrective action and a later retest, with explicit retest outcome; do not infer resolution from a changed status alone.

requirements.summary: The guide states the Contracting Officer may withhold costs equivalent to time lost and retesting/aborted tests under the described circumstances.
requirements.machine_checkable_expectation: Use as a commercial qualification trigger only after confirming the actual project's applicable clause, actual economic consequence, accountable decision owner, deadline and payer. A generic guide alone is not evidence that money is currently withheld.

requirements.summary: The final commissioning report may need to include outstanding deficiencies and resolutions, completed checklists, functional/integrated test records, the construction-phase plan, issues log, training attendance and design/submittal review reports as set by the project specification.
requirements.machine_checkable_expectation: Compare submitted report manifest with the specific project's required artifact list; distinguish absent required artifacts from items not applicable to this project.

requirements.summary: The guide describes submission timelines for an initial/final commissioning report after team validation of the relevant tests, with conditions and tailoring options.
requirements.machine_checkable_expectation: Only enable a deadline check when the project-specific contract version confirms the applicable deadline and triggering event.

requirements.summary: The guide includes commissioning-team presence and Government witness rights; project-specific roles and witness requirements must be checked.
requirements.machine_checkable_expectation: Require witness linkage only where the applicable project checklist/contract says a witness is required; missing scope or authority makes the check UNKNOWN.

known_limits: These records are authored paraphrases for traceability, not a substitute for reading the source document.
The source is a generalized federal guide specification, not actual project execution evidence.
No claim is made that any real project had a defect, withheld payment, delay, or readiness failure.
Rules marked as not implemented are research/data requirements, not claims about the current executable's capability.
